rows.note: Use this for an organized programme of study; it is the all-purpose choice for an education course.

example.english: This course is quite suitable for beginners.
example.traditional: 呢個課程幾適合初學者。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 fo3 cing4 gei2 sik1 hap6 co1 hok6 ze2

rows.note: Use this when a meal course is served as a particular dish, such as a first or main course.

example.english: The first course is the appetizer.
example.jyutping: dai6 jat1 dou6 coi3 hai6 tau4 pun4

rows.note: Use this for the sequence or unfolding process of events.

example.english: The course of events took longer than I imagined.
example.traditional: 成件事嘅過程比我想像中耐。
example.jyutping: sing4 gin6 si6 ge3 gwo3 cing4 bei2 ngo5 soeng2 zoeng6 zung1 noi6

rows.note: Use this for the route or path followed by a person or moving thing.

example.jyutping: ni1 gaa3 baa1 si2 haang4 ni1 tiu4 lou6 sin3
